plan.title: RFQ empty delivery location blocks publish

steps.note: Open the Single Stage create screen.
Switch the event type from the initial RFP mode to RFQ.
Choose the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is rendered.
Add one searched CYLINDER line item with quantity 10 while leaving delivery location unfilled.
Verify that the RFQ sheet includes the delivery-location column under test.
Confirm the delivery location remains empty before publishing.

args.label: Enter the title of this event

steps.note: Verify that the automatic title has not been generated while the required location is empty.
Add one QA test vendor so the publish attempt is complete except for the empty delivery location.
Commit the 30-minute schedule from the footer schedule control.
Press Publish Event and assert that publishing is refused because the delivery location is required.
Assert the empty Delivery location cell is reported as a required field.
